note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative: the clause is a placeholder, never real contract text; times are fictional labels. "Clause linked" and "external text" are supplied, neutral configurations of equal weight: they only say where each supplied scenario shows the clause slip (in the contract set's dock, or still in the auxiliary document's dock). No incorporation rule, no conclusion that the clause is or is not part of anything, no winner and no jurisdiction is stated. Brief customizable fields not exposed (coordinator decision BRIEF CUSTOMIZABLE FIELDS, 2026-10-05): the clauses list, schedules, definitions and priorities. The item exposes the parties, the auxiliary document, its single clause slip (label and placeholder value), the contract set, both scenarios' sequences and configurations, the changed and shared facts and the comparison labels; the single placeholder clause carries the motif's core content (where the slip ends).

presets.name: long-labels-stress
presets.description: Long names, labels, captions, references, headings, clause and time labels, two shared facts and a neutral note; the auxiliary document's receipt and the clause station supplied with one position (order to be examined). Coordinator decision (standing cap rule, 2026-09-26, SESSION_HANDOFF / AUTHORING item 20; re-derived in the ct-01 fix, 2026-10-05): three fields are capped, each still longer than the baseline — the auxiliary document's heading at 39 characters (baseline 30; 43 fails), the clause text at 18 (baseline 15; 20 fails) and the neutral note at 60 (baseline empty; 68 fails). TRUE driver: 1:1 with labels shown. Any one of the three at its pre-cap length (heading 58, clause text 25, neutral note 69 characters — re-invented values, the builder's originals were lost) makes the right-hand column (colR: the comparison table and the notes) taller than the frame, and the search falls back to the collapse-and-fade layout, whose stages leave the frame at the guide. Not drivers: 9:16 (stages stacked; every pre-cap value fits there at 16.1 px with 61.9 model px heads, ≥ 60 px drawn) and 16:9 (16.1 px, 57.7 model px heads, unchanged). The changed fact is no longer capped: at its pre-cap 62 characters 1:1 keeps colR (16.1 px, 55.2 model px heads). Pre-cap values and measurements: production/scratch/contract-formation-11/LAW-0483.stress.precap.json.
